gaps.explanation: Statement total receipts 6,529,670 (trimmed p6). Detail = 6,624,762, above by 95,092 = the statement's Sale of surplus 95,092 (p6 Total; General Fund 3,359 + Road 91,733, p5). The General Fund budget schedule (p10) prints Local 606,110 (total 4,809,386) vs the combining statement's General Fund column Local 602,751 (total 4,806,027, p7); the Road budget schedule (p11) prints Local 99,043 (total 1,363,806) vs the statement's Road column Local 7,310 (total 1,272,073, p5). Detail splits those budget Local lines into Local + 'Local (Sale of surplus)' 3,359 (detail index 3) and 91,733 (detail index 39), both in section revenue, because the budget schedules count sale of surplus as receipts while the statement prints it under other financing. 3,359 + 91,733 = 95,092; 6,624,762 - 95,092 = 6,529,670. No fix (the amounts are printed inside the schedules' receipts).

No fix.
